PART I
Item 1. Business

The Company designs accelerated computing platforms used across data center, gaming, professional visualization and automotive markets. Its software platform and developer ecosystem are described by management as a durable advantage.

Products are sold through original equipment manufacturers, system builders, distributors and directly to cloud service providers.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Export controls applicable to advanced computing products could restrict the Company’s ability to sell certain products into affected regions, and changes to those controls may occur with limited notice.

A substantial portion of revenue is concentrated among a small number of customers, and the loss of any one of them could materially affect results.

Manufacturing depends on a limited number of foundry and packaging partners, and capacity constraints have previously affected the ability to meet demand.
